fields.Institution: Bharati Vidyapeeth Institute of Management and Research (BVIMR)
fields.Approval / Accreditation: UGC deemed university; AICTE; NAAC A++
fields.Intake — Published:
180 MBA seats (official BMAT2026 brochure)
Published numeric intake: 180
fields.Fees — Published:
₹4 lakh first-year regular-merit tuition in 2026–27, with 5% annual escalation: calculated two-year tuition ₹8.2 lakh. Institutional-quota first-year tuition ₹5.6 lakh.
Numeric fee reference ₹L: 8.2
fields.Fee Scope: Calculated 2-year regular-merit tuition from published 4 L/year and 5% annual rise; extras excluded
fields.Eligibility: Bachelor’s degree of minimum three years after 10+2 with at least 50% marks, or 45% for SC/ST; final-year candidates provisionally eligible with originals due 30 September 2026.
fields.Selection Process: University portal offers an application route with a valid recognised national/state management entrance score, or the BV-BMAT-2026 route for those without such a score; complete university admission/counselling formalities.
fields.Application / Vacancy Signal: Official university/BVIMR page advertises MBA applications against vacant seats for 2026–27; campus-specific remaining seat count not shown.

Reported median ₹L: 7
